title:
The familiar form,
made clear.
subtitle: 3D / CHALET EXTERIOR
body: A classic architectural render studies the retained roof, timber balcony and stone base alongside the enlarged glazing. Faceted mountains and simplified trees keep the proposed building in focus.

title:
Old rhythm.
New openness.
subtitle: 3D / LIVING ROOM MODEL
body: A shaded interior model brings the beams, green tiled stove and new view opening into one composition. Simple materials make the room proportions and furniture arrangement easy to discuss.
